how.title: HOW TO BECOME A RANDONNEUR
how.subtitle: It’s not a race. It’s a personal adventure against the clock. Follow these core steps to ride, survive, and earn your first official homologation.
how.step1.title: Pick a Brevet
how.step1.desc: Select an event from the calendar. Beginners should start with a 200km route to understand pacing and nutrition limits.
how.step2.title: Prepare Your Gear
how.step2.desc: Ensure your bike is road-worthy. You must carry lights, reflective gear, and tools. Self-sufficiency is the golden rule.
how.step3.title: Ride & Check-In
how.step3.desc: Navigate using GPS or cue sheets. Stop at designated Control Points (CPs) to validate your passage via our SMS bot.
how.step4.title: Get Homologated
how.step4.desc: Finish within the time limit. Your results are sent to Audax Club Parisien in France and officially recorded worldwide.
home.wondering_desc: Riding hundreds of kilometers in a single go sounds intimidating, but it's more about pacing, eating, and stubbornness than pure speed. Here are the facts to get you to the start line.
home.community_desc: Our community of veteran randonneurs is here to help you gear up.
